revelation.10.p1.b1.text: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.

revelation.10.p1.b2.text: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

revelation.10.p2.b3.text: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.

revelation.10.p2.b4.text: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, …

revelation.10.p2.b5.text: “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”

revelation.10.p3.b6.text: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.

revelation.10.p3.b8.text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, …

revelation.10.p4.b9.text: “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”

revelation.10.p4.b10.text: “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

revelation.10.p4.b11.text: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth, …

revelation.10.p4.b12.text: … but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.

revelation.10.p5.b13.text: “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”
